```esql
FROM employees
| EVAL m = emp_no IN (FROM employees | SORT emp_no ASC | LIMIT 3 | KEEP emp_no)
| WHERE emp_no <= 10004
| SORT emp_no ASC
| KEEP emp_no, m
```

| emp_no:integer | m:boolean |
| --- | --- |
| 10001 | true |
| 10002 | true |
| 10003 | true |
| 10004 | false |
